mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wall_anonymous_config (anonymous_avatar, anonymous_nickname, sort_num, is_deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{anonymousAvatar}, #{anonymousNickname}, #{sortNum}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE wall_anonymous_config SET anonymous_avatar = #{anonymousAvatar}, anonymous_nickname = #{anonymousNickname}, sort_num = #{sortNum}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, anonymous_avatar, anonymous_nickname, sort_num, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM wall_anonymous_config WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, anonymous_avatar, anonymous_nickname, sort_num FROM wall_anonymous_config WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_num DESC
